interpretation: Illustrative aligned-spin in-family parameter-space coverage and runtime only; no minimal-match threshold, population coverage, or retention claim.

kernel_benchmark.semantics: CPU complex-IFFT kernel with precomputed data FFT and templates; excludes PSD estimation, waveform generation, normalization, and I/O

limitations: The grid is an explicit feasibility stress grid, not a population prior.
Coverage is in-family and aligned-spin; it does not establish coverage for precession, eccentricity, higher modes, or waveform-systematic error.
No minimal-match acceptance threshold is defined or implied.
